page_title: NIC 1-0 MAR | Nice v Marseille 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Ruddy Buquet is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' The free kick into the penalty area from Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is cleared.

90+7' Melvin Bard (Nice) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Marseille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+5' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+4' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and it's Gaetan Laborde (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+4' Here's the change. Jeremie Boga leaves the pitch and Romain Perraud (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' The corner by Jordan Veretout (Marseille) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
90+1' Renan Lodi (Marseille) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Jordan Veretout provides the assist in the box, but Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
88' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
87' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends a long ball forward to Ismaila Sarr, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

85' A cross by Renan Lodi (Marseille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.

83' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Jordan Veretout (Marseille), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. Renan Lodi (Marseille) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
82' Evann Guessand (Nice) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his effort on goal goes well wide of the right post. A really poor shot.
82' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
81' Here is a change. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang is going off and Gennaro Gattuso gives the last tactical orders to Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
81' Substitution. Amine Harit will be replaced by Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille).
79' Terem Moffi (Nice) gets a yellow card, off the field.

79' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick!Pablo Rosario sends a cross in and Evann Guessand (Nice) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the top of the net and the score changes to 1:0.
78' This was really stupid from Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Ruddy Buquet.
75' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

74' OFF THE POST! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
73' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Terem Moffi is replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
72' Morgan Sanson goes off the pitch and Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) comes on.
72' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
70' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ruben Blanco intercepts the ball.
69' 7:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
65' Terem Moffi (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Terem Moffi (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) offside.
62' What a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Marcin Bulka dived superbly to deny Amine Harit (Marseille), whose header was directed to the bottom right corner.
61' Close! Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
60' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pau Lopez leaves the pitch to be replaced by Ruben Blanco (Marseille).
58' Pau Lopez (Marseille) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
57' Pau Lopez (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' The referee allows time for a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi will be replaced by Jordan Veretout (Marseille).
56' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
56' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Terem Moffi, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
55' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Pau Lopez.
54' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) swings it in and Ismaila Sarr gets on the end of it, but Marcin Bulka shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
53' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
50' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
50' A quickly taken corner by Nice.
49' Morgan Sanson (Nice) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Gennaro Gattuso decided to make a change. Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is replaced by Michael Murillo.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) tries to find Azzedine Ounahi, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.

45+1' Terem Moffi (Nice) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Pau Lopez displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Francesco Farioli is forced to make a change. Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pablo Rosario.
43' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
41' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Terem Moffi (Nice) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
38' Half-chance! Renan Lodi (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Marcin Bulka reacts well to snuff out the attack.
34' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
31' Amine Harit (Marseille) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ismaila Sarr, but Marcin Bulka displays great awareness to stop him.
30' The total number of attempts is 1:1. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
28' Morgan Sanson (Nice) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
24' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jeremie Boga (Nice) was quite harsh and Ruddy Buquet didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Jeremie Boga (Nice) releases Terem Moffi with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
19' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) trips an opposition player and Ruddy Buquet signals a foul.
15' Dante (Nice) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
14' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle after Morgan Sanson (Nice) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) sends a long cross over to Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, but Marcin Bulka comes forward to gather the ball.
5' PENALTY APPEAL after Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
3' Morgan Sanson (Nice) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
3' Morgan Sanson (Nice) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Nice earn a corner.
2' Jonathan Clauss flicks on the near post corner to Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
2' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) will take a corner kick.
2' Amine Harit (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Marseille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ruddy Buquet.
